collector.registration: engine/src/state-sources.mjs and engine/src/collectors/precision-probes.mjs register three bounded, isolated Denver Metro CityHive sources behind the legacy precision runtime.

storeIdentity.proof: Every inventory row must match one frozen first-party host, source chain, merchant ID, store ID, city, ZIP, and normalized premises address. Multi-store Molly's rows are resolved only by their exact allowlisted merchant and premises pair.

sourceSemantics.availability: CityHive pickup offers with positive quantities below 100 preserve exact retailer-reported counts; values at or above 100 are binary orderability only. Every row remains verify-before-driving.

stateFilter.assertion: Lifecycle-backed website state controls include Colorado.

areaFilter.assertion: Drop Feed client/API filters and strict location matchers expose only Denver Metro.

preferences.assertion: Account-owned preferences normalize and persist the exact Denver Metro selection.

dashboard.assertion: Dashboard state and area controls expose Denver Metro with the lifecycle caveat.

dropFeedApi.assertion: The Drop Feed API parses and applies the strict Denver Metro query filter.

finder.assertion: Exact public store IDs and addresses remain searchable through lifecycle-backed website location surfaces.

alerts.assertion: Central confidence and export policy re-run the metro identity and inventory guard so forged host, merchant, premises, geography, availability, format, or precision dimensions fail closed.

monitoring.assertion: The legacy precision runtime contains source failures, records explicit roadblocks, and preserves healthy sibling sources plus only still-fresh cache evidence for isolated source loss.

export.assertion: Engine export policy retains exact versus binary CityHive quantity semantics and revalidates metro retailer identity before projecting an actionable inventory lane.

shadow.reason: Three isolated alert-disabled live collector runs passed with exact source and premises identity.

canary.reason: Two coherent alert-disabled canary snapshots passed state integration verification.

production.assertion: This manifest documents implemented engine contracts only and does not claim production deployment.
production.reason: Production promotion and website wiring were outside the authorized engine-only scope.
